get.summary: List the categories of the plugins
get.description: Answers the categories of the plugins of the proxy engine, the built-in ones and the ones the plugins declare, sorted by name. The backoffice groups the plugins by category.

200.description: The names of the categories, sorted by name regardless of case

400.description: The credentials are missing: the call carries no api key, and the route that serves the admin api refuses it before the controller runs

401.description: The credentials are wrong, or they do not give access to the admin api

429.description: The quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded

get.summary: List the steps of the plugins
get.description: Answers the steps of the handling of a request where the plugins of a route run, in the order the backoffice shows them.

200.description: The steps where the plugins of a route can run, `Job` and the steps of the data exporters left out

get.description: Answers the plugins of the proxy engine that can be added to a route, the internal ones left out, like `GET /api/plugins/all`. This documentation endpoint is public on the backoffice host. When the `otoroshi.doc-resources.accessKey` setting is set (outside of the dev mode), it requires the basic credentials `doc:<accessKey>`, or the `doc_secret` query parameter. On the host of the admin api, it is served through the route of the admin api and requires its credentials.

parameters.name: doc_secret
parameters.description: The access key of the documentation (`otoroshi.doc-resources.accessKey`), or the base64 encoding of `doc:<accessKey>`, when it is set

200.description: The plugins that can be added to a route, with their default configuration and their configuration form, in json

400.description: On the host of the admin api, the credentials of the admin api are missing

401.description: The access key of the documentation is set and neither the basic credentials nor `doc_secret` give it, or, on the host of the admin api, the credentials of the admin api are wrong

429.description: On the host of the admin api, the quotas of the credentials, or the number of calls allowed per ip address, are exceeded
